claims.statement: Capt. Wm. Richards secured the trophy (printed as pail) from the first championship game at the Union base ball grounds, planning to have it gilded and presented to Tom Allen to hang in his Market Street saloon.
claims.excerpt:
Richards secured the
pail, which he intends having gilded, and
then, under instructions from Mr. Lucas,
he will present it to Tom Allen
places: Union base ball grounds, St. Louis

notes: The object is printed as pail (probably ball); the presentation is planned, not confirmed.
